Description: Volunteers support the California Department of Aging by assisting local service providers in reaching millions of seniors and individuals with disabilities. Typical tasks include delivering meals to home-bound residents, providing transportation to healthcare appointments, and visiting the elderly to provide social contact. Highly committed volunteers can also train as Long-Term Care Ombudsmen to advocate for resident rights or join the HICAP program to provide health insurance counseling.
Address/Virtual: Various locations across California (Contact your local Area Agency on Aging for specific addresses)
